products.heading: Our products for schools
products.intro: Products of our own for schools, built on the same engineering we bring to client work.

platform.title: AI-powered platform for smart schools
platform.body: An integrated digital ecosystem that uses artificial intelligence to improve learning, streamline administration and raise student engagement. It delivers personalized learning paths, real-time analytics, automated grading and smart resource management.

timetabling.title: AI-powered timetabling
timetabling.body: An intelligent scheduling system that automates the creation and optimization of academic timetables. It compares timetables generated from different inputs and constraints, talks users through their scheduling goals, and reports on room use and capacity.

items.a: XionTechs offers digital product engineering, digital insights and analytics, product co-creation, and staffing services. These services leverage emerging technologies like AI/ML and generative AI. XionTechs focuses on industries such as EdTech, healthcare, logistics, and private equity.

items.q: How do you ensure data security?
items.a: With an integrity mindset, XionTechs maintains honesty and transparency in all dealings, ensuring client data is protected through ethical standards and responsible practices. Security automation and continuous scanning further enhance data protection.

items.q: How do you run a project?
items.a: We follow the 4-D process: Discovery, Design, Development and Deployment. The team works with Agile practices and an AI-driven workflow, and project management is metric-driven, so you read quality and progress in numbers.

items.q: How do you measure and demonstrate value?
items.a: XionTechs measures and demonstrates value by tracking metrics related to speed, quality, product impact, and team autonomy. This metric-driven performance approach ensures transparency and accountability while demonstrating tangible results and validating ROI.
